query: select current_timestamp as observed_at, current_user as observer_role, jsonb_build_object('message',(select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('public.rpc_send_agreement_message(uuid,text)')),'selection',(select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('public.rpc_select_response(uuid,integer,uuid,integer,text,text)')),'propose',(select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('public.rpc_propose_agreement_change_v2(uuid,integer,jsonb,text,text)')),'respond',(select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('public.rpc_respond_agreement_change(uuid,boolean)')),'emitter',(select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid=to_regprocedure('private.emit_event(uuid,text,text,text,uuid,integer,text,text,text,text,jsonb,timestamptz)'))) as predecessor_hashes,(select count(*) from information_schema.columns where table_schema='public' and ((table_name='user_activity_events' and column_name='read_at') or (table_name='notification_push_devices' and column_name='revision'))) as new_columns_present,(select count(*) from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and indexname in ('activity_inbox_page_idx','activity_inbox_unread_idx','delivery_inbox_copy_idx','push_device_active_token_owner_idx')) as new_indexes_present,(select count(*) from pg_proc where pronamespace='public'::regnamespace and proname in ('rpc_list_inbox','rpc_mark_activity_event_read','rpc_mark_inbox_read','rpc_resolve_activity_event','rpc_get_push_device','rpc_set_push_device')) as new_functions_present,(select count(*) from (select expo_push_token from public.notification_push_devices where active group by expo_push_token having count(*)>1) d) as duplicate_active_tokens,(select value from private.marketplace_config where key='urgent_activation_policy') as urgent_policy,(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('policy',policy_key,'version',version,'role',beneficiary_role,'reason',activation_reason,'mode',charge_mode,'basis',unit_basis,'cost_rsd',platform_cost_rsd)) from private.connection_policy_versions) as connection_policy,jsonb_build_object('publication_bundles',(select count(*) from private.publication_policy_bundles),'publication_decisions',(select count(*) from private.need_publication_decisions),'qa_questions',(select count(*) from private.preselection_qa_questions),'qa_commands',(select count(*) from private.preselection_qa_commands),'activations',(select count(*) from private.connection_activations),'profiles',(select count(*) from public.app_profiles),'needs',(select count(*) from public.needs),'responses',(select count(*) from public.marketplace_responses),'selections',(select count(*) from public.need_selections),'agreements',(select count(*) from public.agreements),'messages',(select count(*) from public.agreement_messages),'events',(select count(*) from public.user_activity_events),'deliveries',(select count(*) from public.notification_deliveries),'devices',(select count(*) from public.notification_push_devices),'preferences',(select count(*) from public.notification_preferences),'push_attempts',(select count(*) from public.notification_push_attempts)) as counts;
